metadata.description: CortadOS Router mods for Claude Code.

plugins.name: cortados-pulse
plugins.description: A pane beside the chat with the CortadOS router's live resource pool: usage, subscription scarcity, online devices and model fit.

plugins.name: cortados-routed-subagents
plugins.description: Routes every subagent this session spawns through the CortadOS provider (S1 picks the model, it runs headless on the provider host, its tool calls run back here). The main session stays on direct Claude.
